spec_match.rationale: Runs the real hinted call, names AudioSelectionPreferenceEnum's sole 'preferred' value, and honestly reports the observable outcome rather than claiming the hint caused it.

interactive.rationale: The capture, preview, getSettings() read-back and analyser-driven level meter are real, but the success path never re-enables either button (stopBtn.disabled=true from click start is never cleared, and captureBtn stays disabled too), so after a successful capture the page's own controls deadlock until pagehide/reload.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The blurb promises the single hinted call with label, settings, and a live level meter, and the page implements exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Rejection, pagehide races, and audio-absent shares are handled, but the post-success control deadlock is an unhandled state and there is no track.onended handler for the browser's native 'stop sharing' UI.

references.rationale: ChromeStatus 5085785343787008 (verified) and the audioSelection spec anchor are linked.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite passed 8/8 in this browser, including the track-inspection and cleanup surfaces this page depends on.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via CLI: probe 'callable', placeholder/meter/meta initial states correct, console clean (fonts.googleapis.com failure environmental); the capture flow needs a real picker so the deadlock was established by code trace, not by clicking.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts record resolved (audio/video presence) and fallback outcomes plus injected global error capture.

design_system.rationale: Variables and button overrides are correct, but the emerald 'callable' text on stone (~3.7:1) misses AA at its small size.

accessibility.rationale: The meta output is a polite role=status and buttons are native, but the level meter is a role=img with a static label that never conveys the level non-visually, and the control deadlock equally strands keyboard users.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Harness-validated ok/ok recorded in responsive-support.json (2026-07-24); the constrained video-wrap and wrapping rows fit narrow viewports; this session's own 360px CLI capture is inconclusive due to the headless min-width clamp.

openQuestions.title: Re-enable Stop (and eventually Capture) after a successful capture
openQuestions.detail: captureBtn.addEventListener sets stopBtn.disabled=true at click and the success branch (lines that assign stream, start the meter, and set stopBtn.textContent) never sets stopBtn.disabled=false or calls restoreControls(), so on any browser where the capture succeeds the user cannot stop it or start another from the page — only the browser's own sharing bar or navigation ends it. Enable Stop on success, and add a track 'ended' listener so stopping via browser UI also restores the controls and tears down the analyser.

openQuestions.title: Expose the audio level non-visually
openQuestions.detail: The level meter is role=img with the fixed label 'Captured audio level'. Switch to role=meter with aria-valuenow updates (throttled) or mirror a coarse textual level ('silent/low/loud') into the status line so the page's headline observable is not visual-only.

openQuestions.title: Raise the emerald probe text to AA
openQuestions.detail: Shared with the sibling pages: .ok emerald on stone measures ~3.7:1 at 0.78rem, below the 4.5:1 bar.

summary: The core demo is honest and real — hinted capture, track read-back, live meter, pagehide race handling — but a control-flow bug means a successful capture strands both buttons (Stop is never re-enabled), which is exactly the state most real visitors on supporting browsers will hit; fix in place with the smallest patch. Also missing: non-visual level output and an 'ended' handler for browser-side stop. Verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via CLI (screenshots, DOM, clean console); the picker flow cannot be driven headlessly, so the deadlock is code-trace evidence and runtime evidence is partial. Mobile parity relies on the harness-recorded ok/ok from 2026-07-24.
